title: Telegram link previews, explained in 60 seconds
description: The short version: what Telegram reads from a page, why it caches previews per URL, and how to get a fresh card every time.

blocks.text: When you paste a link, Telegram's servers fetch the page once and build a card from its **Open Graph** tags: site name, title, description and image.

items: **Bots don't run JavaScript.** The tags must be in the HTML the server sends — this site renders them on the server.
**Previews are cached per exact URL.** That includes a cached *no preview* if the link was shared before the page existed.
**A new URL means a fresh card.** Share buttons here use `/posts/<slug>/<version>`, which changes whenever the post does.

blocks.title: Stale preview?
blocks.text: Send the link to [@WebpageBot](https://t.me/WebpageBot). This blog does that automatically after every publish once the Telegram secrets are set.
Want the long version? Read [How Telegram builds a link preview](/posts/telegram-link-previews-explained).
